Critical.policy: Non-negotiable. Fixed 100%. Never cut under any plan or replan.

High.policy: Essential. Fixed. Protected against discretionary trimming.

Medium.policy: Semi-flexible. Max cut 30%. Objective penalty weight: 3.0 (cut second).

Low.policy: Discretionary. Max cut 75%. Objective penalty weight: 1.0 (cut first).

infeasibility_thresholds.slack_limit: Infeasible when any r_t > Rs 1.0 or g > Rs 1.0 after max allowed cuts
infeasibility_thresholds.risk_limit: Infeasible when reserve-breach probability > locked max_risk (default 15%)
